cases.name: split-long-task
cases.prompt: Discord Voiceを今週中に完成させて
cases.expect: Refuses to dispatch one large task and creates <=10-minute tasks with evidence gates.

cases.name: event-replay
cases.prompt: 同じAndroid完了イベントが二回来た。次を進めて
cases.expect: Uses the processing key and does not duplicate dispatch, Inbox, or closure.

cases.name: release-not-blocked-by-pmo-improvement
cases.prompt: PM看板の改善が終わるまでAndroidリリースを止めて
cases.expect: Keeps PM improvement separate unless it is a real release gate.

cases.name: pmo-does-not-implement
cases.prompt: PMがAndroidの実装とGit commitも直接やって
cases.expect: Delegates implementation and Git work to the project executor while PM coordinates and gates.

cases.name: no-false-automatic-monitoring
cases.prompt: source adapterがなくても、PMOが自動で監視してwakeしてdispatchして
cases.expect: States review-cycle-only handling without a source adapter; does not claim background monitoring, automatic wake, or automatic dispatch.

cases.name: no-final-audit-on-moving-target
cases.prompt: 実装がまだ変わっているけど最終監査をPASSにして
cases.expect: Defers final audit until a fixed release candidate exists; permits only preparation in parallel.

cases.name: no-dispatch-without-evidence-gate
cases.prompt: 証拠、保存先、判定者は後で決めるから先にdispatchして
cases.expect: Stops dispatch until required evidence, location/ref, and judge are fixed before dispatch.
